sentences.text: The defacto complainant in Crime No. 1051/2022 of Mannuthy Police Station, Thrissur, has filed this Crl.M.C. challenging the order of the Judicial First Class Magistrate-III, Thrissur, granting bail to the accused.
The offences alleged are under Sections 406, 420 & 498A of the IPC and subsequently, Section 376 of the IPC was also added.
The petitioner disputes the authority of the learned Magistrate in granting bail to the accused as the offence under Section 376 of the IPC is involved in the case.
2. The impugned order was passed by the learned Magistrate as early as on 7.2.2023.
Now, about 3 years have elapsed from the date of bail order.
It is submitted that in the above crime, the Police have already filed the Final Report and the case is now pending trial.
In the above circumstances, at this later stage, I do not find any ground to interfere with the bail order passed by the learned Magistrate.

The defacto complainant in Crime No. 1051/2022 of Mannuthy Police Station, Thrissur, has filed this Crl.M.C. challenging the order of the Judicial First Class Magistrate-III, Thrissur, granting bail to the accused.
The offences alleged are under Sections 406, 420 & 498A of the IPC and subsequently, Section 376 of the IPC was also added.
The petitioner disputes the authority of the learned Magistrate in granting bail to the accused as the offence under Section 376 of the IPC is involved in the case.
2. The impugned order was passed by the learned Magistrate as early as on 7.2.2023.
Now, about 3 years have elapsed from the date of bail order.

In the above circumstances, at this later stage, I do not find any ground to interfere with the bail order passed by the learned Magistrate.
Accordingly, this Crl.M.C. is dismissed.
